honest_limits: Every one of the 194 child artifacts is 0 bytes with mtime within ~50 ms of birthtime. The artifact store therefore yields dispatch START times only; per-child FINISH times are unrecoverable for earlier waves. Real finish times exist only where a host completion notification supplied duration_ms (the three finished children above). Earlier-wave durations are NOT asserted here rather than fabricated. Filed as an observability defect in docs/backlog/GAPS.md.

The 194-artifact census proves a dispatch BURST cap, which is strong evidence but not identical to a concurrency proof: a burst bounds how many children were started together, not how many were simultaneously alive. The concurrency proof is the sweep over the four sessions with observed clocks in this window (peak 3 children / 4 sessions).
Earlier-wave role attribution is not asserted. Only sessions whose agent type the coordinator dispatched directly in this window are role-labelled.
Legacy OpenCode worktrees on this host are prior-session artifacts, preserved untouched. No live foreign coordinator was observed, and this attestation covers sessions on this host only.

Cancellation, event-wait and restart-recovery clauses are exercised by the deterministic ledger tests (tests/sessionLedger.test.mjs), which fail closed on missing finish records, contradictory status and time-order inversion. The host exposes no cancellation or restart API to this session, so those clauses are validated at the ledger-contract level, not by killing a live child.
